item.title: Overview of Lamentations - When a City Falls and God Still Speaks 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections Opening Story # Imagine a man walking through the ruins of a city he once loved. The air is thick with the smell of smoke, and the stones beneath his feet are still warm from the fires that consumed homes, markets, and memories. He pauses beside a collapsed wall where children once played, and he tries to remember the sound of their laughter, but the silence presses against him like a weight. He moves on, stepping over shattered pottery, torn garments, and the remnants of a life that vanished in a single season of violence. Every corner he turns reveals another reminder of what used to be: a doorway with no house behind it, a street with no people to walk it, a temple with no worshippers to fill it.
